<module id="div_8bit">
    <description>A simplified radix-2 divider for 8-bit signed or unsigned integers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">The clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst">The reset signal to initialize or reset the module.</input>
        <input id="sign">Indicates if the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0).</input>
        <input id="dividend" width_description="[7:0]">The 8-bit input dividend for division.</input>
        <input id="divisor" width_description="[7:0]">The 8-bit input divisor for division.</input>
        <input id="opn_valid">A 1-bit signal indicating that a valid operation request is present.</input>
        <input id="res_ready">A 1-bit signal indicating that the 16-bit output result has already been acknowledged.</input>
        <output id="res_valid">A 1-bit output signal indicating the result is valid and ready.</output>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">The 16-bit output containing the remainder in the upper 8 bits and the quotient in the lower 8 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="NEG_ONE">-1</parameter>
        <parameter id="ZERO">0</parameter>
        <parameter id="ONE">1</parameter>
        <parameter id="TWO">2</parameter>
        <parameter id="NINE">9</parameter>
        <parameter id="EIGHT">8</parameter>
        <parameter id="SEVEN">7</parameter>
        <parameter id="SIX">6</parameter>
        <parameter id="FIVE">5</parameter>
        <parameter id="FOUR">4</parameter>
        <parameter id="THREE">3</parameter>
        <parameter id="TWO">2</parameter>
        <parameter id="ONE">1</parameter>
        <parameter id="ZERO">0</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="res_valid_reg">Register to hold the res_valid signal.</reg>
        <reg id="start_cnt">Register to indicate the start of the division process.</reg>
        <reg id="cnt">Register to keep track of the number of iterations.</reg>
        <reg id="neg_divisor">Register to store the negative value of the divisor.</reg>
        <reg id="dividend_abs">Register to store the absolute value of the dividend.</reg>
        <reg id="divisor_abs">Register to store the absolute value of the divisor.</reg>
        <reg id="remainder">Register to store the remainder during division.</reg>
        <reg id="quotient">Register to store the quotient during division.</reg>
        <reg id="SR">Shift Register to store the current value of the dividend.</reg>
        <always @(posedge clk or posedge rst)>
            if(rst == 1'b1)begin
                res_valid_reg <= ZERO;
                start_cnt <= ZERO;
                cnt <= ZERO;
                neg_divisor <= ZERO;
                dividend_abs <= ZERO;
                divisor_abs <= ZERO;
                remainder <= ZERO;
                quotient <= ZERO;
                SR <= ZERO;
            end else begin
                if(opn_valid == ONE && res_valid_reg == ZERO)begin
                    dividend_abs <= (sign == ONE)? ((dividend[7]==ONE)? (~dividend + ONE): dividend): dividend;
                    divisor_abs <= (sign == ONE)? ((divisor[7]==ONE)? (~divisor + ONE): divisor): divisor;
                    SR <= {dividend_abs, ONE};
                    neg_divisor <= ~(divisor_abs) + ONE;
                    cnt <= ONE;
                    start_cnt <= ONE;
                end else if(start_cnt == ONE)begin
                    if(cnt[3] == ONE)begin
                        cnt <= ZERO;
                        start_cnt <= ZERO;
                        SR <= {remainder, quotient};
                    end else begin
                        cnt <= cnt + ONE;
                        case({SR[15], SR[14]})
                            TWO: begin
                                remainder <= SR[15:8];
                                quotient <= SR[7:0];
                            end
                            default: begin
                                remainder <= SR[15:8] + neg_divisor;
                                quotient <= SR[7:0];
                            end
                        endcase
                        SR <= {remainder[6:0], quotient[7], remainder[7]};
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Division operation starts when opn_valid is high and res_valid is low
        if (opn_valid == 1'b1 && res_valid == 1'b0) begin
            // Save the inputs
            dividend_abs = (sign == 1'b1) ? ((dividend[7] == 1'b1) ? (~dividend + 1'b1) : dividend) : dividend;
            divisor_abs = (sign == 1'b1) ? ((divisor[7] == 1'b1) ? (~divisor + 1'b1) : divisor) : divisor;
            // Initialize the shift register SR with the absolute value of the dividend shifted left by one bit
            SR = {dividend_abs, 1'b0};
            // Set NEG_DIVISOR to the negated absolute value of the divisor
            neg_divisor = ~(divisor_abs) + 1'b1;
            // Set the counter cnt to 1 and start_cnt to 1 to begin the division process
            cnt = 1'b1;
            start_cnt = 1'b1;
        end
        
        // If start_cnt is high, perform the division process
        if (start_cnt == 1'b1) begin
            // If the counter cnt reaches 8 (most significant bit of cnt is set), the division is complete
            if (cnt[3] == 1'b1) begin
                // Clear the counter cnt and start_cnt
                cnt = 1'b0;
                start_cnt = 1'b0;
                
                // Update the shift register SR with the final remainder and quotient
                SR = {remainder, quotient};
            end else begin
                // Increment the counter cnt
                cnt = cnt + 1'b1;
                
                // Perform the subtraction of NEG_DIVISOR from SR
                case ({SR[15], SR[14]})
                    2'b00: begin
                        // If the result is non-negative, update SR with the result
                        SR = {SR[15:8] + neg_divisor, SR[7:0]};
                    end
                    2'b01: begin
                        // If the result is positive, update SR with the result
                        SR = {SR[15:8] + neg_divisor, SR[7:0]};
                    end
                    2'b10: begin
                        // If the result is negative, update SR with the result
                        SR = {SR[15:8] + neg_divisor, SR[7:0]};
                    end
                    2'b11: begin
                        // If the result is negative, update SR with the result
                        SR = {SR[15:8] + neg_divisor, SR[7:0]};
                    end
                endcase
                
                // Shift the result left by one bit
                SR = {SR[15:8], SR[7:0]};
            end
        end
        // Manage res_valid based on reset signal, counter, and result consumption
        if (rst == 1'b1) begin
            res_valid = 1'b0;
        end else if (cnt == 4'b1000) begin
            res_valid = 1'b1;
        end else if (res_valid == 1'b1 && res_ready == 1'b1) begin
            res_valid = 1'b0;
        end else begin
            res_valid = res_valid;
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
